GRCh38.note: HLA-A gene body on PGF reference haplotype (Ensembl/UCSC); classical MHC region chr6:28510120-33480577

HPRC_pangenome_v1.1.note: highly polymorphic; pangenome carries multiple HLA-A alleles per region — coordinate placeholder, true representation is allele-graph

copy_count_typical: 1 (single locus, but >9000 known alleles per IPD-IMGT/HLA)
architecture_note: HLA-A is a single-copy gene per haplotype, but the classical MHC class-I sub-region (HLA-A/B/C plus HLA-E/F/G non-classical) is a complex_mosaic of paralogous gene blocks formed by ancient duplication. Pure HLA-A/B/C paralogs typically fall below the Bailey ≥90 % / ≥1 kb SD threshold across full gene bodies, so the classification here is pragmatic (read-mapping ambiguity from extreme allelic diversity + paralog cross-mapping) rather than a strict Bailey SD. See segdup_class_taxonomy.md §HLA-A/B/C entry and Open question #1.

exon_2.note: Exon 2 of HLA-A encodes the α1 domain of the peptide-binding groove and is the primary hyperpolymorphic region. Allele-specific PSVs cluster here. KEINE Sequenz aus IPD-IMGT/HLA hier eingebettet (CC-BY-ND); see IPD-IMGT/HLA database (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ipd/imgt/hla/) for allele-specific PSV positions and reference sequences.

exon_3.note: Exon 3 encodes the α2 domain — the second hyperpolymorphic region. Together exons 2+3 carry the bulk of HLA-A coding diversity (Parham 1989; Robinson IPD-IMGT/HLA).

exon_4.note: Less polymorphic; useful as a relative anchor in mapping.

diagnostic_features.snp_density_note: HLA-A is one of the most polymorphic genes in the human genome (>9000 alleles in IPD-IMGT/HLA Release 3.55+, 2024). Per-position diversity in exons 2/3 is orders of magnitude higher than genome average — single-reference mapping breaks down without allele-aware logic.

ipd_imgt_reference.license: CC-BY-ND (external reference only — sequences MUST NOT be copied into LLmap catalog)
ipd_imgt_reference.use: Resolve allele-specific PSVs and reference sequences at runtime via API, not at catalog-build time

gene_conversion_evidence.note: Inter-allelic gene conversion in HLA class I is classical (Parham 1989; Chen 2007 reviews). Conversion tracts between HLA-A alleles and between HLA-A and HLA-B/C paralogs contribute to allele diversification.

primary.note: max_mismatch=4 (higher than IGHG4=2) because per-position diversity in exons 2/3 is extreme; require_unique_chain=false because HLA-A reads also cross-map to HLA-B/C/E/F/G paralogs. Mapper SHOULD consult IPD-IMGT/HLA allele database for final assignment.

fallback_chain.name: relaxed_mismatch
fallback_chain.rationale: extreme allelic diversity exceeds standard mismatch budget

fallback_chain.name: llm_checkpoint
fallback_chain.rationale: novel allele evaluation against IPD-IMGT/HLA via API
